title: decide where the interop harnesses live
description: Interop artifacts today: A1 Haven-encoded fixtures + generator are committed (crates/mimi-protocol/tests/fixtures/haven). Not in the repo: the A2 reverse cross-check (mimid dump test + Haven-side harness) and the B3/B4 live harness (unshare + socat + driver), all under /home/mark/Cache/mimid-haven-xcheck. Readings: (a) keep them outside the repo (tests stay offline, no third-party build in mimid); (b) commit them under a tools/interop directory excluded from the workspace and CI, so others (IETF 127 hackathon, Haven) can rerun them. Mark decides.
